meta.name: dev-ultraqa
meta.description: QA cycling workflow — repeat build/lint/test/fix cycles up to 5 times until all checks pass. Stops early if the same error repeats 3 times (signals a fundamental issue, not a fixable one).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动循环构建、检查、测试直到全部通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望自动重复修复直到所有检查通过
copy.tagline_en: Automatically cycle build, lint, test until all pass
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automated retry cycles until all checks pass

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会重复运行构建、代码检查和测试，最多5轮，直到全部通过。如果同一错误连续出现3次，会停止并报告为根本性问题。
howto.when: 在你完成多文件修改后、合并前要求所有检查通过，或重构可能引入回归时触发。

say.text: 检查整个项目，确保构建和测试都通过
修复当前所有构建和测试错误
say.note: 循环尝试修复直到通过

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will repeatedly run build, lint, test, and fix cycles up to 5 times until all checks pass. If the same error appears 3 times in a row, it stops and reports a fundamental issue.
howto.when_en: Triggered after multi-file implementation, pre-merge when all checks are required, or after refactoring that risks regressions.

say_en.text: Run the full QA cycle on the project
Fix all current build and test errors
